claim.quote: A simultaneous measurement of the muon decay parameters {\rho}, {\delta}, and (P_{\mu}){\xi} tests the Standard Model (SM) in a purely leptonic process and provides improved limits for relevant extensions to the SM.

date.note: arXiv v1 submission date; the journal reference was not retrieved.

name: New Experimental Constraints for the Standard Model from Muon Decay

significance.value: 90% C.L. limits on the left-right symmetric model

summary.plain: The TWIST collaboration measured three parameters that describe how positrons are emitted when polarized muons decay, testing the Standard Model in a purely leptonic process. The abstract gives improved limits on a right-handed weak force of g_R/g_L times zeta below 0.020.
summary.technical: Simultaneous measurement of rho, delta and P_mu xi from the positron energy-angle spectrum of highly polarized muon decays; for the generalized left-right symmetric model |(g_R/g_L) zeta| < 0.020 and (g_L/g_R) m_2 > 578 GeV/c^2 (both 90% C.L.).

title: New Experimental Constraints for the Standard Model from Muon Decay
why_it_matters: The abstract says the measurement tests the Standard Model in a purely leptonic process and provides improved limits for relevant extensions of it.
